remarks: You'll fall in love with this stately 1930 Colonial with all the charm and details of the era. Beautifully crafted woodwork throughout. Gracious Entry Hall leading to formal DR and LR/with fireplace and built-ins; Study; Sunny FR with walls of glass overlooking rose garden and backyard; bright, cheery Kitchen with vintage Pantry; even a bygone telephone room and back staircase from Kitchen leading to BR/Bath which could be used for 5th BR, Office, or Playroom. Main 2nd Floor has 4 BRs and 2 Full Baths. Two BRs could be combined with adjoining Bath for MBR Suite. There is walk-up Attic that is sheet rocked with heat and A/C, large unfinished Basement, and attached heated 2-car Garage. Lots of storage throughout! Sited on .35 acre with a beautiful landmark maple tree gracing the front yard and fenced-in backyard with very spacious slate patio...perfect for entertaining. There is extra parking area for visitors. Included is a vintage playhouse. A very special, one-of-a-kind offering ready to be lovingly updated. This estate property is being sold as-is. No disclosures. Great opportunity to own this well-built vintage home!
